lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: You made it past the mire, but do not drop your guard just yet.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: What kind of place is this dense forest ahead?

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: The Whispering Woods. The canopy is so thick that daylight never touches the forest floor.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: A lone avenger lurks in those shadows. His blade is as swift and merciless as lightning.

lines.speaker: Player
lines.text: Shadows or lightning, nothing stands between me and my goal.

lines.speaker: Old Man
lines.text: Trust your instincts, not your eyes. Step into the shadows with caution.
